provenance.quote: An actuator capable of reciprocal linear driving and rolling driving comprising a reciprocal linear driving unit and a rolling driving unit
the shaft being pivoted to be enabled reciprocal linear driving in the axial direction thereof
the reciprocal linear driving unit comprising: a first moving object having the shaft and first permanent magnets
the rolling driving unit comprising: a second moving object having the shaft, a second yoke fixed on the shaft
a first moving object having the shaft and first permanent magnets
first permanent magnets each magnetized so that polarities of both end portions in the axial direction of the shaft are different
a first stator having a coil disposed to face end faces of the first permanent magnets parallel to the axial direction of the shaft
a coil disposed to face end faces of the first permanent magnets parallel to the axial direction of the shaft
a second moving object having the shaft, a second yoke fixed on the shaft
a second yoke fixed on the shaft
at least one second permanent magnet attached to adjoin the second yoke around the axis of the shaft
a tubular shaped second stator having a second coil wound around the axis of the shaft to enclose the second moving object
a second coil wound around the axis of the shaft
second stationary yokes disposed to face an outermost peripheral portion of the second yoke and the second permanent magnet
a switching means for switching among a mode for driving only the first moving object reciprocally and linearly in the axial direction of the shaft
spring members supporting the first moving object in the axial direction of the shaft
a common vibrational absorption spindle is provided in the vibration system of the reciprocal linear driving
spring receiving members are further comprised so as to restrict rotation of arms at both ends of the coil springs
spring hook portions which are not movable with respect to the first stator and the second stator
a magnetic shielding member of tubular shape or ring shape which is made of a nonmagnetic material
a plurality of first yokes fitted to and fixed on the shaft
an iron core of substantially tubular shape fitted to the shaft
the first stator further comprises a first bobbin around which the first coil is wound
at least a first stationary yoke provided on any side of the first bobbin in the axial direction of the shaft
torsion and compression coil springs
the first moving object being driven reciprocally and linearly in the axial direction of the shaft
the second moving object being driven rollingly around the axis of the shaft in a predetermined angle region
switching among a mode for driving only the first moving object reciprocally and linearly in the axial direction of the shaft
